description: This Java class 'PreferenceServices' provides services for managing user preferences, including retrieving, setting, removing, copying preference groups, and handling individual preferences within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PreferenceServices
classes.description: A class providing static methods for user preference management services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getUserPreference
methods.description: Retrieves a single user preference based on type and optional group, returning preference data and value.

methods.name: getUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a group of user preferences for a specified group type, optionally including user-specific preferences and default values.

methods.name: setUserPreference
methods.description: Stores or updates a single user preference with specified type, group, and value.

methods.name: removeUserPreference
methods.description: Removes a specific user preference based on user login ID and preference type.

methods.name: setUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Stores or updates a group of user preferences.

methods.name: copyUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Copies a preference group from one user to another.
